summary.title: Startup Pitch Deck Collection
summary.one_liner: A searchable index of 576 real venture-backed startup pitch decks, filterable by stage, fundraise size, country and category, for studying what to include (and avoid) in your own deck.
keywords: what to put in a pitch deck
takeaways: The collection holds 576 real pitch decks from VC-funded startups, each tagged with funding stage, raise amount, country and category.
Decks can be browsed by stage (Angel through Series-F, plus Grant and Growth), by fundraise size from under $1m to over $150m, by country, and by industry.
The page's stated purpose is to show what to do, and mainly what not to do, when building a startup pitch deck.
Most entries are Seed (191) or Series-A (159), and the USA (386) and UK (85) account for most of the listed companies.
summary.summary: This page is an index of 576 pitch decks from venture-capital-funded startups, collected to show founders how real decks were used during fundraising. Each entry gives a one-line company description, funding stage, raise amount and category, and the page offers filters for stage, fundraise size, country and industry. The page itself contains no written tutorial text; the value is in browsing the listed examples. Some entries have missing amounts (N/A) and a few are noted as parody or duplicates.
